question: Which city ranked first in Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan 2024 among cities with population above 10 lakh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indore** has consistently ranked as one of the cleanest cities in India under various cleanliness and environmental surveys conducted by the Government of India.
 
• In the **Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan 2024**, Indore secured the first position among cities with a population above 10 lakh, showcasing its commitment to improving air quality and sustainable urban living.
 
• The survey evaluates cities based on parameters such as **air quality improvement**, **pollution control measures**, and adherence to the National Clean Air Program (NCAP).
 
• Indore's initiatives include the promotion of **public transport**, implementation of green energy solutions, and stringent monitoring of industrial emissions.
 
• Indore's achievements in waste management and its focus on reducing vehicular pollution have significantly contributed to its top ranking in this survey.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan:**

 
 
• This survey is part of the **National Clean Air Program (NCAP)**, aimed at reducing air pollution levels by 20-30% by 2024 compared to 2017 levels.
 
• It categorizes cities based on population and evaluates their efforts in achieving clean air standards.
 
• The survey emphasizes innovative urban planning, the adoption of renewable energy, and the reduction of vehicular and industrial emissions.
 
 
 
• **National Clean Air Program (NCAP):**
 
 
• Launched by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) in **January 2019**, the NCAP is a comprehensive plan to tackle air pollution at both regional and urban levels.
 
• The program focuses on a collaborative and participatory approach involving various stakeholders, including state governments, urban local bodies, and citizens.
 
• It sets specific targets and action plans for cities to improve air quality over time.
 
 
 
• **Indore’s Achievements:**
 
 
• Indore has been a pioneer in waste segregation, achieving 100% waste segregation at the source.
 
• The city operates a highly efficient **door-to-door waste collection system** and has established several **composting plants** for organic waste processing.
 
• It has adopted policies to promote the use of electric vehicles and improve public transportation systems to mitigate vehicular emissions.
 
 
 
• **Other Top Cities:**
 
 
• Cities like **Ahmedabad**, **Bengaluru**, and **Mumbai** have also made significant progress in their air quality improvement measures but are yet to match the comprehensive efforts of Indore.
 
• These cities are implementing green energy projects, improving public transport infrastructure, and strengthening air quality monitoring networks.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Parameters for Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan:**

 
 
• Reduction in PM10 levels.
 
• Implementation of policies to curb vehicular pollution.
 
• Adoption of clean energy solutions and renewable energy projects.
 
• Public awareness campaigns and citizen participation.
 
 
 
• **Indore’s Sustainable Practices:**
 
 
• The city has prioritized afforestation and green belt development to enhance air quality.
 
• Regular monitoring of pollution levels through an integrated air quality monitoring system has been implemented.
 
• Public-private partnerships have played a significant role in sustaining its clean city status.
